title: campanula rotundifolia var. ruscinonensis
intro: Campanula rotundifolia var. ruscinonensis, commonly known as the Dalmatian bellflower, is a plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative and calming effects, which are attributed to its ability to act as a gentle nervine and a sedative. The bioactive constituents present in Campanula rotundifolia var. ruscinonensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are also supported by its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
